subject: Reasoning
question: As per following Venn diagram, which subject was taken by the largest number of students ? [The Venn diagram consists of four overlapping circles representing four subjects: History (top), Mathematics (left), Geography (right), and Science (bottom). The numbers in each region are: History only: 16; Mathematics only: 9; Geography only: 9; Science only: 19; Intersection of Math & History: 14; Intersection of History & Geography: 12; Intersection of Math & Science: 15; Intersection of Science & Geography: 16; Intersection of Math, History & Science: 18; Intersection of History, Geography & Science: 18; Intersection of Math, History & Geography: 13; Intersection of Math, Geography & Science: 13; Intersection of all four subjects at the center: 20.]
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Add every region that includes Science — only-Science (19), plus each overlap touching Science — and the total comes to 119, ahead of History (111), Mathematics (102), and Geography (101). In four-set Venns, count each subject by sweeping every zone where its circle appears.

subject: Reasoning
question: Identify the number that comes in place of the question mark. 2, 12, 30, 56, 90, ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. The gaps between terms grow by 8 each step: 10, 18, 26, 34 — so the next gap is 42 and 90 + 42 = 132. When second differences stay constant, the next term follows by adding that fixed increment to the last gap.

subject: Reasoning
question: Sham is taller than Ram. Ram is taller than Amir. Sudhir is taller than Shishir. Shishir is taller than Ram. Who is shortest among all ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. From the chain — Sham > Ram > Amir and Sudhir > Shishir > Ram — Amir sits below Ram with no one shorter named below him, so Amir is shortest. Line up all five names on one height ladder before picking the extreme.

subject: Reasoning
question: In the given example, study the first three pattern and select what comes in place of question mark. [The figure contains four circles. Each circle has four numbers outside at the top, bottom, left, and right positions, and one number inside the center. Circle 1: Top 3, Left 2, Right 5, Bottom 4; Inside 196. Circle 2: Top 5, Left 1, Right 4, Bottom 3; Inside 169. Circle 3: Top 3, Left 5, Right 5, Bottom 3; Inside 256. Circle 4: Top 7, Left 6, Right 5, Bottom 3; Inside ?]
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. In each circle the four outer numbers sum to a value whose square fills the centre: 14² = 196, 13² = 169, 16² = 256; for 7 + 6 + 5 + 3 = 21, we get 21² = 441. Spot the repeated squaring rule across the first three figures before solving the fourth.

subject: Reasoning
question: Suppose in your watch it is 9 O' clock. If the hours hand is in west direction, then what is the direction of minute hand ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. At 9 o'clock the minute hand sits at 12; if the hour hand at 9 points west, the whole dial is rotated so that the 12-position faces north. Picture the rotated clock face — where 12 sits fixes the minute hand's direction.

subject: Reasoning
question: A certain amount was to be distributed among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4 respectively, but was erroneously distributed in the ratio 7 : 2 : 5 respectively. As a result of this, B got Rs. 30,000/- less. What is the amount ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. B's correct share is 3/9 of the total and the wrong share is 2/14; the shortfall is (3/9 − 2/14) = 4/21 of the whole amount, and 4/21 × Total = ₹30,000 gives Total = ₹1,57,500. Ratio-error sums always compare each person's correct fraction with what they actually received.

subject: Reasoning
question: Pankaj, Kiran and Anil, these three were given Rs. 1,000/- in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5, so how many rupees will come to Kiran's share ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Kiran's ratio part is 3 out of 2 + 3 + 5 = 10, so Kiran gets (3/10) × ₹1,000 = ₹300. In a simple split, one person's share equals their ratio part divided by the total of all parts, times the whole sum.

subject: Reasoning
question: Observe the figures and select an appropriate figure at the place of question mark. [The first part shows a circle and a triangle, followed by a composite figure where the circle is placed on top of the triangle's apex. The second part shows a horizontal rectangle and a vertical rectangle, followed by a question mark.]

options.A: A vertical rectangle placed centrally on top of a horizontal rectangle, forming an inverted 'T' shape
options.B: A vertical rectangle placed on the left end of a horizontal rectangle, forming an 'L' shape
options.C: A vertical rectangle placed on the right end of a horizontal rectangle, forming a mirror-image 'L' shape
options.D: A horizontal rectangle placed centrally on top of a vertical rectangle, forming a standard 'T' shape

explanation: The right pick is option D. The first pair stacks the circle on the triangle's apex; the second pair should stack the horizontal rectangle centrally on top of the vertical one — a standard T shape. Non-verbal analogies repeat the same positional relationship between the two shapes.

subject: Reasoning
question: 1 1/2 ÷ 3 3/5 = ? Choose correct option from the following.
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Convert to fractions: 1½ ÷ 3⅗ = (3/2) ÷ (18/5) = (3/2) × (5/18) = 15/36. Mixed-number division becomes straightforward once both values are written as improper fractions.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Select the correct statement/s from the following : A. PRERNA – launched its pilot phase from January 15, 2024 to February 17, 2024 at a vernacular school in Vadnagar, Gujrat. B. The PRERNA is a week-long residential program designed for selected students from class V to VIII.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. PRERNA's pilot did run from 15 January to 17 February 2024 at a vernacular school in Vadnagar, Gujarat; statement B misstates the programme design, so only A holds. Scheme questions often test the exact launch window and pilot location.

subject: History
question: The 'Sengol' scepter installed in the new building of the Indian Parliament is the symbol of which empire/reign ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. The Sengol sceptre placed in the new Parliament building draws on the Chola tradition of handing over the royal staff as a symbol of just rule and transfer of power. The 2023 installation explicitly linked this ceremony to Chola heritage.

subject: Current Affairs
question: The 70th National Film Award best male playback singer has been awarded to Arijit Singh for the song __________.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. At the 70th National Film Awards, Arijit Singh won Best Male Playback Singer for "Kesariya" from Brahmāstra. Film-award PYQs usually pair the artist with the exact song title, not just the film.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Paetongtarn Sinvatra, Ex-Prime Minister of Thailand is the leader of which political party ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Paetongtarn Shinawatra, who briefly served as Thailand's Prime Minister in 2024, belongs to the Pheu Thai Party founded by her father Thaksin Shinawatra. Track party names alongside leaders when international appointments appear in the paper.

subject: Current Affairs
question: In January 2025 who has been selected as Secretary of Board of Control for Cricket in India ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Devjit Saikia was elected Secretary of the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in January 2025, succeeding Jay Shah in that administrative role. BCCI office-bearer changes are regular current-affairs fare for MPSC.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Match the pairs – (Arjuna Award, 2024). List 'A' (Sports person) A. Vantika Agrawal B. Jarmanpreet Singh C. Abhay Singh D. Swapnil Kusale List 'B' (Sports) i. Shooting ii. Squash iii. Hockey iv. Chess
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Arjuna Award 2024 went to Vantika Agrawal (chess), Jarmanpreet Singh (hockey), Abhay Singh (squash), and Swapnil Kusale (shooting) — matching iv, iii, ii, i. Arjuna lists are tested as sport-to-player pairs, so learn each recipient's discipline.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Which day is celebrated as World Happiness Day every year ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The United Nations observes International Day of Happiness on 20 March every year, coinciding with the March equinox. UN observance dates — 20 March for Happiness, 21 June for Yoga — are worth a quick revision list.

subject: Geography
question: Lake Victoria is boardered by which of the following countries ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Lake Victoria — Africa's largest lake by area — is bordered by Tanzania, Uganda, and Kenya on its shores. The three-country rim around Victoria is a standard map fact for world-geography questions.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Who among the following is the recipient of the Lokmanya Tilak National Award 2024 ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Sudha Murthy received the Lokmanya Tilak National Award for 2024, recognising her contributions to social work and literature. Maharashtra-linked national awards frequently feature prominent public figures from the state.

subject: Reasoning
question: Suppose A, B and C can do a piece of work in 20, 30 and 60 days respectively. In how many days A can do the work if he is assisted by B and C on every third day ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. A's rate is 1/20 per day; in each block of three days he works alone on two days (2/20) and all three together on the third (1/20 + 1/30 + 1/60 = 1/10), so one block finishes 1/5 of the work — five such blocks, i.e. 15 days, complete the job. Cycle-based time-and-work sums become quick once you tabulate work done per repeating period.

subject: Current Affairs
question: India's first glass bridge has been inaugurated in which state ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. India's first glass bridge was inaugurated in Tamil Nadu, adding to the state's list of recent tourism infrastructure headlines. First-in-India landmarks are often framed as state-specific current-affairs items.

subject: Reasoning
question: Which of the following is a rational number ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Expanding (√2 + 1/√2)² gives 2 + 2 + 1/2 = 9/2, a ratio of integers, so it is rational; the other options involve √5, √3 or π and stay irrational. Rational-or-irrational items often yield to quick simplification rather than decimal guessing.

subject: Reasoning
question: Number of students from Prakruti Vidyalaya and Sanskruti Vidyalaya appearing in different examinations is given in following bar graph : [Bar graph: Y-axis Number of students 0–35; X-axis English Olympiad, Maths Olympiad, General Knowledge, Debate; Prakruti Vidyalaya (grey): English 20, Maths 10, General Knowledge 25, Debate 10; Sanskruti Vidyalaya (black): English 10, Maths 15, General Knowledge 30, Debate 5] The number of students from Prakruti Vidyalaya appearing in English olympiad examination is how much times the difference of total number of students from two schools appearing in all these examinations ?
explanation: The right pick is option D. Prakruti's English Olympiad count is 20; totals for the two schools are 65 and 60, so the difference is 5, and 20 ÷ 5 = 4 times. Read each bar, add school-wise totals first, then compare — the wording is clumsy but the arithmetic is straightforward.

subject: Reasoning
question: The graph below provides data on a Common Entrance Examination CEE conducted in different years. By what percent did the number of questions decrease from CEE 2000 to CEE 2006 ? [Bar graph: Y-axis No. of Questions 10–60; X-axis CEE 2000–CEE 2006; CEE 2000: 55, CEE 2001: 52, CEE 2002: 50, CEE 2003: 48, CEE 2004: 46, CEE 2005: 44, CEE 2006: 40]
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Questions fell from 55 in CEE 2000 to 40 in CEE 2006 — a drop of 15 on the 2000 base, i.e. (15/55) × 100 = 27.27%. Percent decrease always uses the original year as the denominator, not the final count.

subject: Reasoning
question: A number when divided by 5 leaves a remainder 3. What is the remainder when the square of the same number is divided by 5 ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. If n leaves remainder 3 on division by 5, then n = 5k + 3 and n² = 25k² + 30k + 9, which leaves remainder 4 when divided by 5. Remainder patterns for squares modulo small divisors are worth memorising for speed.

subject: Reasoning
question: A farmer has taken a loan of Rs. 20,000. He agreed to return this amount with total interest of Rs. 2,800 in 12 installments. The amount of every installment is less by Rs. 100 than the previous installment. What is the amount of the first installment ?
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Principal plus interest is ₹22,800 across 12 installments decreasing by ₹100 each; summing an AP gives 12a − 100 × 66 = 22,800, so the first installment a = ₹2,450. Decreasing-installment problems are standard arithmetic-progression sums.

subject: Reasoning
question: The classification of skilled workers is shown in the pie diagram. If the number of workers in the production sector is 450, then the total number of skilled workers working in the construction field will be _________. [Pie diagram: Agri 60°, Production 90°, Construction 72°, Other 138°]
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Production's 90° slice corresponds to 450 workers, so total skilled workers = 450 × (360/90) = 1,800; construction's 72° share is 1,800 × (72/360) = 360. In pie-chart items, one known sector fixes the whole population.

subject: Reasoning
question: Study the Venn diagram given below. [Venn diagram: Rectangle (doctors), Triangle (singers), Circle (artists), Square (sports players); Rectangle only: 9; Rectangle and Circle: 12; Rectangle, Circle and Triangle: 4; Rectangle and Triangle: 11; Triangle only: 5; Circle only: 3; Circle and Square: 10; Rectangle, Circle and Square: 6; Square only: 7; Rectangle and Square: 13] i. Rectangle represents doctors. ii. Triangle represents singers. iii. Circle represents artists. iv. Square represents sports players. Who among the following is neither a singer nor a sports player but is an artist and a doctor ?
explanation: The right pick is option D. We need doctor ∩ artist, excluding anyone in the singer (triangle) or sports (square) sets — that is exactly the rectangle–circle overlap of 12, not the regions that also touch triangle or square. Venn questions reduce to listing set conditions and picking the labelled region that satisfies all of them.

subject: Reasoning
question: A large solid cube is formed from the metal obtained by melting three smaller solid cubes of 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm side length. What is the ratio of the total surface areas of the smaller cubes and the large cube ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Combined volume 27 + 64 + 125 = 216 cm³ gives a large cube of side 6 cm (surface 216 cm²); the three smaller cubes total 6(9 + 16 + 25) = 300 cm², so the ratio is 300 : 216 = 25 : 18. Melting problems preserve volume but change total surface area — do not equate the two.

subject: Reasoning
question: A train starts with full of passengers. At the first station, it drops one third of the passengers and takes 280 more. At the second station, it drops one half of the new total and takes 12 more. On arriving at the third station, it is found to have 248 passengers. Find the number of passengers in the beginning.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Starting with x passengers: after station 1 there are 2x/3 + 280; halving and adding 12 at station 2 gives x/3 + 152 = 248, so x = 288. Reverse-step passenger problems are easiest when you write the count after each stop.

subject: Reasoning
question: Which of the following number is completely divisible by each of 8, 9, 10, 11 ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Divisibility by 8, 9, 10 and 11 together requires the LCM 3,960; only 47,520 is an exact multiple (47,520 ÷ 3,960 = 12). For combined divisibility, find the LCM of all divisors and test options against it.

subject: Reasoning
question: For m = 2, what is the value of (- 4m)⁻⁴ ÷ (8m)⁻³ ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. With m = 2, (−4m)⁻⁴ ÷ (8m)⁻³ = 16³ ÷ (−8)⁴ = 4096/4096 = 1. Negative-index division flips to positive powers in the numerator — keep track of the base signs separately.

subject: Polity
question: As per which of the following Section of the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 the procedure for fixing the responsibility on designated officer for repeated failures is given ?
explanation: The right pick is option A. Section 12 of the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 lays down the procedure for fixing responsibility on the designated officer when services are repeatedly delayed or denied. State service-delivery Acts are high-yield for MPSC — note section numbers alongside key duties.

subject: Polity
question: As per S. 6(3) of the Right to Information Act, 2005 where an application is made to public authority requesting for an information which is held by another public authority, the public authority to which such application is made shall transfer the application to that other public authority within the maximum period of __________.

options.A: Seven days from the date of receipt of application
options.B: Five days from the date of receipt of application
options.C: Three working days from the date of receipt of application

explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Section 6(3) of the RTI Act, 2005 requires the receiving public authority to transfer an application to the authority that holds the information within five days of receipt. RTI timelines are frequently tested — five days for transfer, thirty for supply (with extensions in defined cases).

subject: Polity
question: Which Section explains about the penalties in the Right to Information Act, 2005 ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Section 20 of the RTI Act, 2005 deals with penalties for improper refusal of information, delay without reasonable cause, and related offences by Central Public Information Officers. Pair Section 20 with penalties and Section 19 with the appeal mechanism.

subject: Polity
question: Select the correct statement/s from the following. A. The Governor of each State shall appoint a person who is qualified to be appointed as judge of a High Court to be Advocate General for the State. B. The Advocate General shall hold office during the pleasure of the Governor and shall receive such remuneration as the State Legislature may determine.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Article 165 empowers the Governor to appoint as Advocate General a person qualified to be a High Court judge; statement B is wrong because remuneration is determined by the Governor, not the State Legislature. Advocate General basics — appointment by Governor, pleasure tenure — sit under the state executive.

subject: Polity
question: Select the correct statements from the following. A. No person shall be eligible for appointment as governor unless he is a citizen of India and has completed the age of 35 years. B. The governor shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or of a House of Legislature of any state specified in the first Schedule. C. Where the same person is appointed as governor of two or more states, the emoluments and allowances payable to the governor shall be allocated among the states in such proportion as the Parliament may by order determine.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Articles 157 and 158 confirm statements A (citizenship and minimum age 35) and B (no membership of Parliament or a state legislature while Governor); statement C wrongly names Parliament — the President, not Parliament, determines how emoluments are split when one person governs two or more states. Governor eligibility is a compact Article 157–158 package.

subject: Polity
question: Arrange the following states according to their Legislative Council seats in ascending order. A. Maharashtra B. Andhra Pradesh C. Uttar Pradesh D. Telangana E. Karnataka
explanation: The right pick is option A. Legislative Council strengths (ascending): Telangana 40, Andhra Pradesh 58, Karnataka 75, Maharashtra 78, Uttar Pradesh 100 — order D, B, E, A, C. Only six states have Vidhan Parishads; memorising these seat counts saves time in matching questions.

subject: Polity
question: Select the incorrect statement/s from the following. A person shall not be qualified for appointment as a judge of supreme court unless he is a citizen of India and __________. A. Has been for at least ten years a judge of high court or of two or more such courts in succession. B. Has been for at least five years an advocate of a high court or of two or more such courts in succession. C. Is, in the opinion of the President, a distinguished jurist.
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Under Article 124(3), a Supreme Court judge needs five years as a High Court judge (not ten, as in A) or ten years as a High Court advocate (not five, as in B); being a distinguished jurist in the President's opinion (C) is a valid route. Swapping the five- and ten-year thresholds is a classic examiner trap.

subject: Polity
question: Select the incorrect statement about Constituent Assembly. A. 'Lion' was adopted as the symbol of the Constituent Assembly. B. B. N. Rau was appointed as legal advisor to the Constituent Assembly. C. H. V. R. Iyengar was the secretary to the Constituent Assembly.
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Statement A is false — the Constituent Assembly did not adopt the lion as its symbol; B. N. Rau was indeed legal advisor and H. V. R. Iyengar served as secretary. Constituent Assembly facts — personnel and symbols — appear regularly in prelim polity.

subject: Polity
question: Select the correct statement/s from the following. A. Article 137 – Subject to the provisions of any law made by Parliament or any rules made under Article 145, the supreme court shall have power to review any judgement pronounced or order made by it. B. Article 141 – The law declared by the supreme court shall be binding on all courts within the territory of India.
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Article 137 expressly empowers the Supreme Court to review its own judgments, and Article 141 makes the law declared by it binding on all courts in India — both statements reproduce the constitutional text faithfully.

subject: Polity
question: Which State was given special status under Article 370 ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Article 370 (now abrogated) granted Jammu and Kashmir a special autonomous status within the Union, distinct from the other States listed in the options.

subject: Polity
question: Select the correct statements about Chief Minister. A. He is a Chairman of State Planning Board. B. He is a Chairman of Zonal Council. C. He is Vice-Chairman of Inter-State Council. D. He is the Chief Spokesperson of the State Government.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Chief Minister chairs the State Planning Board and acts as the government's chief spokesperson, but the Union Home Minister heads Zonal Councils and the Prime Minister chairs the Inter-State Council — not the CM.

subject: Polity
question: How many languages are included in the eighth Schedule ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option D. The Eighth Schedule currently lists 22 languages — the count rose over time as Sindhi, Konkani, Manipuri, Nepali, Bodo, Dogri, Maithili, and Santhali were added in stages.

subject: Polity
question: In which Part of the Indian Constitution are "Fundamental Duties" mentioned ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment and placed in Part IV-A; Part III holds Fundamental Rights, not duties.

subject: Polity
question: Which of the following is not a fundamental duty ?

options.A: To protect monuments and places of public importance
options.C: To protect and improve the natural environment

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Protecting monuments and places of national importance is a Directive Principle under Article 49, not one of the eleven Fundamental Duties in Article 51A — the other three options are listed duties.

subject: Current Affairs
question: In which year Maharashtra Government launched Swachhtagrih Scheme for rural families ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Maharashtra launched the Swachhtagrih (individual household toilet) scheme for rural families in 1995, well before the later national sanitation drives.

subject: Polity
question: Match the pairs - (Criticism of the Directive Principles of State Policy). 'A' (Critics) A. K. T. Shah B. Ivor Jennings C. K. C. Wheare D. T. T. Krishnamachari 'B' (Statement) i. Pious aspirations ii. Manifesto of aims and aspirations iii. A veritable dustbin of sentiments iv. Pious superfluities

options.A: A – iv, B – i, C – ii, D – iii
options.B: A – iii, B – ii, C – i, D – iv
options.C: A – ii, B – i, C – iii, D – iv
options.D: A – iv, B – ii, C – i, D – iii

explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. K. T. Shah dismissed the DPSP as 'pious superfluities', Jennings as 'pious aspirations', Wheare as a 'manifesto of aims and aspirations', and Krishnamachari as a 'veritable dustbin of sentiments' — the classic pairing set.

subject: Polity
question: Which Article provides protection to the Freedom of Speech of members of Parliament in the Parliament ?
explanation: The right pick is option A. Article 105 shields MPs' freedom of speech and parliamentary privileges inside Parliament — the constitutional provision the question is pointing at.

subject: Polity
question: Who among the following was not a member of the Drafting Committee ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. C. Rajagopalachari served the Constituent Assembly in other capacities but was never a member of the seven-member Drafting Committee headed by Dr. Ambedkar — Saadulla, Mitter, and Gopalaswami Ayyangar were.

subject: History
question: Bhau Mahajan was started the following newspapers.
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Bhau Mahajan, the noted journalist and social worker from Maharashtra, founded Dnyandarshan, Dhumketu, and Prabhakar — three influential Marathi periodicals of the reform era.

subject: History
question: On 31 October 1920 the first session of All India Trade Union Congress was held in Mumbai under whose chairmanship ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The inaugural session of the All India Trade Union Congress on 31 October 1920 in Bombay was presided over by Lala Lajpat Rai, marking a milestone in organised labour politics.

subject: History
question: During the British rule, which tribal was more populated in Umbargaon, Dahanu, Palghar and Jawhar Sansthan area of Thane district ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option C. During British rule the Warli community formed the largest tribal population in the Umbargaon, Dahanu, Palghar, and Jawhar sansthan belt of Thane district.

subject: History
question: Who among the following did not included in the Conference held at Mangaon in Kagal Jahagiri on 21 March 1920 ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. The Mangaon conference of 21 March 1920 in Kagal Jahagiri brought together peasant leaders like Appasaheb Patil, Tukaram Ganeshacharya, and Gangaram Kambale — Dadasaheb Gaikwad was not among those present.

subject: History
question: Which of the statement given below is correct in regard to Narayan G. Chandavarkar ? a. Narayan G. Chandavarkar attended Congress Establishment Session on 28th December 1885. b. According to Narayan G. Chandavarkar, the reason behind rising poverty of India is the rising population. c. Narayan G. Chandavarkar criticized British Government's rising expenditure on military at Congress Session held in Mumbai in 1889. d. Narayan G. Chandavarkar held the position of Vice-chancellor of Mumbai University.
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. Narayan Chandavarkar attended the first Congress session in 1885, criticised military spending at the 1889 Bombay session, and served as Vice-Chancellor of Bombay University — but he blamed British policy, not population growth, for India's poverty.

subject: History
question: Who among the following went to Allahabad in February 1918 to attend the All India Hindu Parishad at invitation of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Dr. Kurtkoti of Maharashtra travelled to Allahabad in February 1918 at Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya's invitation to attend the All India Hindu Parishad.

subject: History
question: Who was felicitated in Pune on 24th September 1894 by a organization called Sarvajanik Sabha ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. The Sarvajanik Sabha of Pune honoured Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj on 24 September 1894, recognising his progressive work on social reform in Kolhapur.

subject: History
question: Who established 'Azad Dal' underground military organization in 1945 ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Nagnath Naikawadi set up the underground armed group 'Azad Dal' in 1945 as part of Maharashtra's militant resistance network during the freedom struggle.

subject: History
question: Arrange the following incidents in their chronological order. a. Establishment of Union of Mill Workers in Bombay. b. First Factory Act. c. Establishment of Workers Welfare Society. d. Establishment of All India Trade Union Congress.
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. The First Factory Act came in 1881, Bombay's mill-workers' union followed around 1890, the Workers' Welfare Society came next, and the All India Trade Union Congress was founded last in 1920.

subject: History
question: Who was the general secretary of the reception committee of the Faizpur Congress Session ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Dhanaji Nana Chaudhari served as general secretary of the reception committee for the Faizpur Congress Session (1936), the landmark session held in rural Maharashtra.

subject: General Studies
question: Who had filed the public interest litigation in the Supreme Court of India to save the Taj Mahal from industrial pollution ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Environmental lawyer M. C. Mehta filed the PIL that pushed the Supreme Court to act on Taj Mahal pollution — leading to orders on industries, green belts, and cleaner fuel around Agra.

subject: General Studies
question: Which one of the following states of India passed the first resolution for Joint Forest Management ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Odisha passed India's first official resolution on Joint Forest Management, bringing local communities and the forest department together to protect and share forest resources.

subject: Geography
question: In 1972 World Vasundhara Conference, the Western Ghats has been declared at which number of the most sensitive region in the world ?
explanation: The right pick is option C. At the 1972 World Vasundhara Conference the Western Ghats were ranked 18th among the world's most ecologically sensitive regions — a reminder of their global conservation value.

subject: Geography
question: Which type of climate is experienced in Maharashtra ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Maharashtra broadly sits in the tropical zone, gets heavy monsoon rain in many parts, and also has distinct dry spells — so tropical, wet, and dry all apply.

subject: Geography
question: As per Forest Survey of India, in which of the following district of Maharashtra there is a highest growth in mangrove forest cover between 2013 to 2023 period ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Forest Survey of India data for 2013–2023 shows Raigarh district recording the highest increase in mangrove cover among the listed Maharashtra coastal districts.

subject: Geography
question: Arrange these river basins in Maharashtra from north to south direction. a. Krishna river basin b. Bhima river basin c. Tapti river basin d. Pravara river basin
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. From north to south across Maharashtra the order is Tapti basin (c), then Pravara (d), Bhima (b), and Krishna (a) — Tapti lies farthest north, Krishna farthest south.

subject: General Studies
question: Under the Kyoto Protocol, which of the following factor requires major domestic changes to reduce it in developed countries ?
explanation: The right pick is option A. The Kyoto Protocol legally binds developed countries to cut greenhouse gas emissions — that is the core domestic policy shift it demands, not tree-felling rules or farm waste alone.

subject: Geography
question: As per 2011 census, ________ Administrative region of Maharashtra observed lowest child sex ratio.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The 2011 Census placed the Aurangabad administrative division at the bottom for child sex ratio among Maharashtra's regions — a figure often linked to Marathwada's demographic pattern.

subject: Science
question: Match the following pairs. Plants a. Hirda b. Khair c. Rosha Grass d. Tendu Leaves Production i. Scent oil ii. Tannin iii. Bidi iv. Katha/Cutch

options.A: a - iv, b - iii, c - i, d - ii
options.B: a - ii, b - iv, c - iii, d - i
options.C: a - ii, b - iv, c - i, d - iii
options.D: a - ii, b - iii, c - iv, d - i

explanation: The verified answer here is option C. Hirda yields tannin, Khair gives katha/cutch, Rosha grass is tapped for scent oil, and Tendu leaves go into bidis — a standard forest-produce matching set.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following mineral is extensively found in Maharashtra ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Iron ore is Maharashtra's most widespread mineral — major deposits run through Gadchiroli, Chandrapur, and the eastern plateau belt, feeding steel plants across the state.

subject: Science
question: What will be the power wattage of bulb which runs on 220 V of home electric supply carrying current of 0.25 A ?
explanation: Working through it, option C is the one. Use P = V × I: 220 V × 0.25 A gives 55 W. Keep this formula handy for quick household electricity calculations.

subject: Science
question: Which Radioactive substance is used as a fuel in nuclear power plant ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. Uranium-235 (and sometimes plutonium) fuels nuclear reactors through controlled fission. Radium and polonium are radioactive but are not power-plant fuel.

subject: Science
question: Choose the correct sentence. i. Sound can travel through vacuum. ii. The frequency of audible sound is 20 Hz to 20000 Hz. iii. When a source of sound moves its frequency observed may be different. iv. Doppler effect is the apparent change in frequency of source when it is moving.

options.B: Only i, ii sentences are correct
options.C: Only ii, iii, iv sentences are correct
options.D: Only i, ii, iii sentences are correct

explanation: The right pick is option C. Sound needs a material medium — it cannot travel through vacuum (i is wrong). Human hearing spans roughly 20 Hz–20,000 Hz (ii), and the Doppler effect covers iii and iv.

subject: Science
question: Organic waste is converted into manure and biogas, is an example of which of the following chemical reaction ? a. Displacement reaction b. Addition reaction c. Substitution reaction d. Decomposition reaction
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Composting and biogas production break complex organic matter into simpler products — that is decomposition, not displacement or addition chemistry.

subject: Geography
question: Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) terms are used to determine extend of pollution in ______________. a. Air b. Sound c. Soil d. Water
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. BOD and COD both measure how much oxygen organic pollutants consume in water — they are standard water-quality indicators, not air, soil, or noise tests.

subject: Science
question: From the following options, the common name of calcium oxychloride is ____________. a. Blue vitriol b. Borax c. Green vitriol d. Bleaching powder

options.A: Only a and b are incorrect

explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. Calcium oxychloride is common bleaching powder (CaOCl₂), used to disinfect water. Blue vitriol is copper sulphate, borax is sodium borate, green vitriol is ferrous sulphate.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following is not an example of fish ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Ichthyophis is a limbless caecilian — an amphibian, not a fish. Scoliodon (dogfish), Hippocampus (seahorse), and Labeo (rohu) are all true fishes.

subject: Science
question: The diagnostic features of birds - ______________. a. Feathers clade b. Air breathing c. Warm blooded d. All of the above
explanation: The right pick is option D. Birds are diagnosed by feathers, air-breathing lungs, and warm-blooded metabolism — all three together, not any single trait alone.

subject: Science
question: Match the animal with its respective phylum. a. Protozoa - i. Butterfly b. Coelenterata - ii. Plasmodium c. Arthropoda - iii. Starfish d. Echinodermata - iv. Hydra
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. Plasmodium belongs to Protozoa, Hydra to Coelenterata, Butterfly to Arthropoda, and Starfish to Echinodermata — match each animal to its correct phylum.

subject: General Studies
question: To control pests on the crops which of the following ways offer a sustainable and environmental friendly approach ? i. Chemical pesticide ii. Mycorrhizae iii. Crop rotation iv. Lichens Which of the following statement given above is/are correct ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option C. Mycorrhizae strengthen crop roots naturally and crop rotation breaks pest cycles — both are eco-friendly. Chemical pesticides harm the environment, and lichens are not a pest-control tool.

subject: Science
question: The first system of plant classification based on natural characters was presented in which year and by whom ?

options.D: 1883, G. Bentham and J. D. Hooker

explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Antoine Laurent de Jussieu laid out the first widely accepted natural system of plant classification in 1789 through his work *Genera Plantarum*. Later systems by the Candolles and by Bentham–Hooker built on this foundation.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following is a plant hormone ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option D. Cytokinins are classic plant hormones that drive cell division and delay leaf ageing. Acetylene is a gas, formalin a preservative, and streptomycin an antibiotic — none of these belong to the plant-hormone group.

subject: Geography
question: Which one of the following is an example of attribute data in GIS ?
explanation: The right pick is option B. In GIS, attribute data describes the qualities of a feature — such as land-use type — while latitude, longitude, and map extent are spatial data tied to location and geometry.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following instrument is used to view the aerial photographs in three dimension ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option B. A stereoscope pairs overlapping aerial photographs so each eye sees a slightly different view, giving a three-dimensional impression of terrain. It is a standard photogrammetry tool, not a storage device.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following science is defined as science of acquiring, processing and interpreting statistical data and images obtained from air craft and satellite ?
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Remote sensing is the science of collecting, processing, and interpreting data and images from aircraft and satellites without physical contact with the target. Aerial photography is one technique within it; GIS and GPS serve different roles.

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following portion of electromagnetic spectrum is used in remote sensing ?
explanation: Working through it, option D is the one. Satellite and aerial sensors routinely use the visible, infrared, and microwave bands — each suited to different surface properties — so all three regions listed are part of remote-sensing practice.

subject: Science
question: The size of the monitor or video display unit is measured in _________ length of the screen.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option C. Monitor and TV sizes are quoted as the diagonal distance across the screen — the standard industry convention buyers see in shop labels.

subject: Science
question: U.R.L. stands for _________ .
explanation: The right pick is option A. URL expands to Uniform Resource Locator — the address string that tells a browser where to fetch a web page or file on the internet.

subject: Science
question: Which of the following is a primary responsibility of the data link layer in the OSI model ?

options.A: Routing packets to their destination across multiple networks
options.B: Encapsulating network layer packets into frames for transmission
options.C: Managing end-to-end communication and ensuring reliable delivery
options.D: Converting data into electrical signals for physical transmission

explanation: The verified answer here is option B. The data link layer (Layer 2) wraps network-layer packets into frames for transmission over a physical link. Routing belongs to the network layer; end-to-end reliability to the transport layer; signal conversion to the physical layer.

subject: Polity
question: The provisions of the 'Information Technology Act, 2000' came into force on _________ .
explanation: The examiner has marked option D. The Information Technology Act, 2000 received presidential assent in June, but most of its operative provisions were notified and came into force on 17 October 2000.

subject: Current Affairs
question: Which is the unhappiest country in the World Happiness Report 2018 ?
explanation: Working through it, option B is the one. The World Happiness Report 2018 placed Burundi at the bottom of the rankings — the least happy country that year — while Finland topped the list.

subject: Economy
question: National Population Policy, 2000 aims to stabilize population by which year ?
explanation: Straight to the answer — option B. The National Population Policy, 2000 set the long-term goal of stabilising India's population by 2045 through improved healthcare, education, and family-planning measures.

subject: Economy
question: Phillips curve shows the relationship between _______.
explanation: The examiner has marked option A. The Phillips curve captures the short-run trade-off between inflation and unemployment — when one tends to fall, the other often rises, a staple macroeconomics graph.

subject: Economy
question: Identify the correct pairs from the given options. List-I i. Economic Planning ii. XIIth Five Year Plan iii. NITI Aayog iv. NITI Aayog Vice-chairperson List-II a. Selection by Prime Minister b. Think Tank group of Indian Government c. Fast and sustainable growth d. Time bound programme

options.A: i – c, ii – a, iii – d, iv – b
options.B: i – d, ii – b, iii – a, iv – c
options.C: i – d, ii – c, iii – b, iv – a
options.D: i – b, ii – d, iii – c, iv – a

explanation: Correct matching (option C): i. Economic Planning → d. Time bound programme ii. XIIth Five Year Plan → c. Fast and sustainable growth iii. NITI Aayog → b. Think Tank group of Indian Government iv. NITI Aayog Vice-chairperson → a. Selection by Prime Minister As per the official answer key, option C.

subject: Economy
question: Absolute poverty is measured by _______.
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Absolute poverty in the Indian planning context is measured by whether a person can afford the minimum calorie intake needed for basic survival — not merely by income or wealth on paper.

subject: Economy
question: Which is a correct statement ? A. Devaluation is the reduction of the exchange value of a currency or its purchasing power in term of other currency. B. The great advantage of devaluation is an increase in import.
explanation: Working through it, option A is the one. Statement A correctly defines devaluation as lowering a currency's exchange value. Statement B is wrong — devaluation usually makes exports cheaper and imports costlier, so it does not increase imports.

subject: Economy
question: ______ was the currency of the International Monetary Fund until December, 1971.
explanation: Straight to the answer — option A. Under the Bretton Woods arrangement, the US dollar served as the IMF's principal currency of account until the system was overhauled in December 1971.

subject: Current Affairs
question: When was the National Food Security Act, 2013 implemented in Maharashtra ?
explanation: The verified answer here is option A. Maharashtra notified and began implementing the National Food Security Act, 2013 from 1 February 2014, extending subsidised food-grain entitlements under the central law.

subject: Economy
question: The most important and traditional method for the government to raise funds to meet its expenditures is through various taxes. In this context, identify which of the following statement(s) is/are correct. a. Taxes on goods are generally direct taxes. b. The Goods and Services Tax (GST) system has been implemented across India since July 1, 2014. c. "One Nation, One Tax" is the core of GST. d. Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a single direct tax implemented across the entire nation, replacing previous many central and state indirect taxes.
explanation: The right pick is option C. Only statement c holds — "One Nation, One Tax" is the core idea of GST. Goods taxes are indirect, not direct; GST rolled out on 1 July 2017, not 2014; and GST itself is an indirect tax replacing many earlier ones.

subject: Economy
question: Role of foreign trade is _________ . a. To earn foreign exchange. b. To encourage investment. c. Lead to division of labour. d. Bring change in composition of exports.
explanation: The examiner has marked option B. Foreign trade earns foreign exchange, attracts investment, and promotes international division of labour through specialisation. Shifting export composition is also a long-run effect, but the keyed answer covers a, b, and c.

subject: Reasoning
question: खालील वेन आकृतीनुसार, जास्तीत जास्त विद्यार्थ्यांनी कोणता विषय निवडला आहे ? [वेन आकृतीमध्ये चार वर्तुळे एकमेकांना छेदतात. वरचे वर्तुळ 'इतिहास', डावे 'गणित', उजवे 'भूगोल' आणि खालचे 'विज्ञान' दर्शवते. आकृतीमध्ये विविध भागांत खालीलप्रमाणे अंक दिले आहेत: इतिहास फक्त-१६, गणित फक्त-९, भूगोल फक्त-९, विज्ञान फक्त-१९, गणित व इतिहास-१४, इतिहास व भूगोल-१२, गणित व विज्ञान-१५, विज्ञान व भूगोल-१६, गणित-इतिहास-विज्ञान-१८, इतिहास-भूगोल-विज्ञान-१८, गणित-इतिहास-भूगोल-१३, गणित-भूगोल-विज्ञान-१३ आणि चारही विषयांच्या मध्यभागी-२०.]
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय B येतो. 'विज्ञान' असलेले सर्व भाग मिळवले — फक्त-विज्ञान (१९) आणि प्रत्येक छेदनभाग — तर एकूण ११९ येते, जे इतिहास (१११), गणित (१०२) आणि भूगोल (१०१) पेक्षा जास्त आहे. चार वर्तुळांच्या वेन आकृतीत प्रत्येक विषयासाठी त्या वर्तुळ असलेले सर्व भाग बेरीज करा.

subject: Reasoning
question: प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी येणारी संख्या कोणती ते ओळखा. 2, 12, 30, 56, 90, ?
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय D. पदांमधील फरक १०, १८, २६, ३४ — प्रत्येक वेळी ८ ने वाढतात; पुढचा फरक ४२, म्हणून ९० + ४२ = १३२. दुसऱ्या-स्तरीय फरक स्थिर असल्यास शेवटच्या फरकात तो वाढीव घालून पुढचे पद मिळते.

subject: Reasoning
question: एक विशिष्ट रक्कम A, B आणि C मध्ये अनुक्रमे 2 : 3 : 4 या प्रमाणात वितरित करायची होती, परंतु ती चुकीने अनुक्रमे 7 : 2 : 5 या प्रमाणात वितरित केली गेली. याचा परिणाम म्हणून B ला रु. 30,000/- कमी मिळाले. तर ती रक्कम किती होती ?
explanation: उत्तरतालिकेनुसार पर्याय A योग्य आहे. B चा योग्य वाटा ३/९ आणि चुकीचा २/१४; फरक (३/९ − २/१४) = ४/२१, आणि ४/२१ × एकूण = ३०,०००, म्हणून एकूण रक्कम १,५७,५०० रु. अशा प्रश्नांत प्रत्येकाचा योग्य आणि चुकीचा वाटा तुलना करून फरक काढा.

subject: Reasoning
question: दिलेल्या उदाहरणात, पहिल्या तीन मांडण्यांचा अभ्यास करून प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी काय येईल ते निवडा. [आकृतीमध्ये चार वर्तुळ आहेत. प्रत्येक वर्तुळाच्या बाहेर चार दिशांना (वर, खाली, डावीकडे, उजवीकडे) संख्या आहेत आणि वर्तुळाच्या मध्यभागी एक संख्या आहे. वर्तुळ १: वर ३, डावीकडे २, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ४; मध्यभागी १९६. वर्तुळ २: वर ५, डावीकडे १, उजवीकडे ४, खाली ३; मध्यभागी १६९. वर्तुळ ३: वर ३, डावीकडे ५, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ३; मध्यभागी २५६. वर्तुळ ४: वर ७, डावीकडे ६, उजवीकडे ५, खाली ३; मध्यभागी ?]
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. प्रत्येक वर्तुळात बाहेरील चार संख्यांची बेरीज करून तिचा वर्ग मध्यभागी लिहिला आहे: १४² = १९६, १३² = १६९, १६² = २५६; ७+६+५+३ = २१, म्हणून २१² = ४४१. पहिल्या तीन आकृत्यांतील वर्गाचा नियम ओळखून चौथ्यासाठी लागू करा.

subject: Reasoning
question: श्याम हा रामपेक्षा उंच आहे. राम हा अमिरपेक्षा उंच आहे. सुधिर हा शिशिरपेक्षा उंच आहे. शिशिर हा रामपेक्षा उंच आहे. तर सर्वात कमी उंच कोण ?
explanation: पर्याय C योग्य आहे. श्याम > राम > अमिर आणि सुधिर > शिशिर > राम — या साऱ्या क्रमात अमिर सर्वात खाली आहे. सर्व नावे एकाच उंची क्रमवारीत लिहून मग सर्वात कमी उंच ओळखा.

subject: Reasoning
question: पंकज, किरण व अनिल या तिघांना रु. 1,000/-, 2 : 3 : 5 या प्रमाणात वाटले. तर किरणच्या वाट्याला किती रुपये येतील ?
explanation: थेट उत्तराकडे — पर्याय C. किरणचा वाटा २+३+५ = १० पैकी ३, म्हणून (३/१०) × १,००० = ३०० रु. साध्या प्रमाण वाटपात एकूण प्रमाणातील आपला भाग गुणून संपूर्ण रक्कम मिळवा.

subject: Reasoning
question: समजा तुमच्या घड्याळात नऊ वाजले आहेत. जर तास काटा पश्चिमेकडे आहे, तर मिनिट काटा कोणत्या दिशेला राहील ?
explanation: सोडवत गेल्यास पर्याय D येतो. नऊ वाजता मिनिट काटा १२ वर असतो; तास काटा ९ वर पश्चिमेला असेल तर १२ची दिशा उत्तर होते. घड्याळ फिरवलेले कल्पून १२ कोणत्या दिशेला आहे ते पाहा — मिनिट काट्याची दिशा ठरते.

subject: Reasoning
question: 1 1/2 ÷ 3 3/5 = ? खालीलपैकी योग्य पर्याय निवडा.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. १½ ÷ ३⅗ = (३/२) ÷ (१८/५) = (३/२) × (५/१८) = १५/३६. मिश्र संख्या अयोग्य भिन्नराशीत बदलल्यावर भागाकार सोपा होतो.

subject: Reasoning
question: खालील आकृत्यांचे निरीक्षण करा व प्रश्नचिन्हाच्या जागी येणारी योग्य आकृती निवडा. [पहिल्या भागात एक वर्तुळ आणि एक त्रिकोण आहे, त्यानंतर एक आकृती आहे ज्यात त्रिकोणाच्या शिरोबिंदूवर वर्तुळ ठेवले आहे. दुसऱ्या भागात एक आडवा आयत आणि एक उभा आयत आहे, त्यानंतर प्रश्नचिन्ह आहे.]

options.A: एक आडव्या आयताच्या मध्यभागी वरच्या बाजूला एक उभा आयत आहे, जो उलट्या 'T' सारखा दिसतो
options.B: एक आडव्या आयताच्या डाव्या टोकाला एक उभा आयत जोडलेला आहे, जो 'L' आकार तयार करतो
options.C: एक आडव्या आयताच्या उजव्या टोकाला एक उभा आयत जोडलेला आहे
options.D: एका उभ्या आयताच्या वरच्या टोकाला मध्यभागी एक आडवा आयत जोडलेला आहे, जो 'T' आकार तयार करतो

explanation: पर्याय D योग्य आहे. पहिल्या जोडीत वर्तुळ त्रिकोणाच्या शिरोबिंदूवर ठेवले आहे; दुसऱ्या जोडीत आडवा आयत उभ्या आयताच्या वरच्या मध्यभागी 'T' आकारात जोडला पाहिजे. अशा आकृती सादृश्यात दोन आकृत्यांमधील स्थानिक संबंध तसाच राहतो.

question: सर्वोत्कृष्ट पार्श्वगायकाचा 70 वा राष्ट्रीय चित्रपट पुरस्कार अरिजीत सिंग ला __________ गीतासाठी प्रदान करण्यात आला.

options.C: नैसर्गिक वातावरणाचे संरक्षण आणि सुधारणा करणे

question: 31 ऑक्टोबर 1920 रोजी मुंबई येथील ऑल इंडिया ट्रेड युनियन काँग्रेसचे पहिले अधिवेशन कुणाच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली भरले ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. 31 ऑक्टोबर 1920 रोजी मुंबईत ऑल इंडिया ट्रेड युनियन काँग्रेसच्या पहिल्या अधिवेशनाचे अध्यक्षपद लाला लजपत राय यांनी सांभाळले — संघटित कामगार चळवळीतील महत्त्वाचा टप्पा.

question: भाऊ महाजन यांनी खालील वर्तमान पत्रे सुरू केली.
explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. महाराष्ट्रातील प्रसिद्ध पत्रकार व समाजसेवक भाऊ महाजन यांनी ज्ञानदर्शन, धुमकेतू आणि प्रभाकर — ही तीन प्रभावी मराठी वर्तमानपत्रे सुरू केली.

question: २१ मार्च १९२० रोजी कागल जहागिरीतल्या माणगाव येथे भरलेल्या परिषदेत खालीलपैकी कोणाचा समावेश नव्हता ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. 21 मार्च 1920 रोजी कागल जहागिरीतील माणगाव परिषदेत आप्पासाहेब पाटील, तुकाराम गणेशाचार्य, गंगाराम कांबळे यांच्यासारखे नेते होते — दादासाहेब गायकवाड यांचा समावेश नव्हता.

question: ब्रिटिश राजवटीत ठाणे जिल्ह्यातल्या उंबरगाव, डहाणू, पालघर आणि जव्हार संस्थानाच्या भागात कोणत्या आदिवासी जमातीची वस्ती अधिक होती ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. ब्रिटिश काळात ठाणे जिल्ह्यातील उंबरगाव, डहाणू, पालघर आणि जव्हार संस्थान भागात वारली आदिवासी जमातीची वस्ती सर्वाधिक होती.

question: सार्वजनिक सभा या नामवंत सभेने (संस्थेने) २४ सप्टेंबर १८९४ मध्ये पुणे येथे कोणाचा सत्कार केला ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. पुण्यातील सार्वजनिक सभेने 24 सप्टेंबर 1894 रोजी छत्रपती शाहू महाराजांचा सत्कार केला — कोल्हापूरातील सामाजिक सुधारणांच्या कार्याची दाद देत.

question: १९१८ फेब्रुवारीत पंडीत मदन मोहन मालवीय यांच्या निमंत्रणावरून अखिल भारतीय हिंदू परिषदेस हजर राहण्यासाठी अलाहाबाद येथे खालीलपैकी कोण गेले ?
explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. महाराष्ट्रातील डॉ. कुर्तकोटी यांनी फेब्रुवारी 1918 मध्ये पंडित मदन मोहन मालवीय यांच्या निमंत्रणावरून अखिल भारतीय हिंदू परिषदेस हजर राहण्यासाठी अलाहाबादला प्रवास केला.

question: नारायण ग. चंदावरकर यांच्याबाबत खालीलपैकी कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे ? अ. २८ डिसेंबर १८८५ रोजी काँग्रेस स्थापनेच्या अधिवेशनाला नारायण ग. चंदावरकर उपस्थित राहिले. ब. नारायण ग. चंदावरकर यांच्या मते हिंदुस्थानच्या वाढत्या दारिद्र्याचे कारण वाढती लोकसंख्या आहे. क. नारायण ग. चंदावरकर यांनी १८८९ च्या मुंबई येथील काँग्रेस अधिवेशनात ब्रिटिश सरकारच्या वाढत्या लष्करी खर्चावर टीका केली. ड. नारायण ग. चंदावरकर यांनी मुंबई विद्यापीठाचे कुलगुरु पद भूषविले.
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. नारायण चंदावरकर 1885 च्या पहिल्या काँग्रेस अधिवेशनात होते, 1889 च्या मुंबई अधिवेशनात लष्करी खर्चावर टीका केली आणि मुंबई विद्यापीठाचे कुलगुरु होते — पण दारिद्र्यासाठी लोकसंख्या वाढ नव्हे, ब्रिटिश धोरण जबाबदार म्हणले.

question: १९४५ मध्ये 'आझाद दल' ही भूमिगत कार्यकर्त्यांची लष्करी संघटना कोणी उभारली ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय A. नागनाथ नायकवडी यांनी 1945 मध्ये 'आझाद दल' ही भूमिगत सशस्त्र संघटना उभारली — स्वातंत्र्यलढ्यातील महाराष्ट्रातील सशस्त्र प्रतिकाराचा एक भाग.

question: पुढील घटनांची त्यांच्या कालक्रमानुसार मांडणी करा. अ. मुंबईतील गिरणी कामगारांची संघटना स्थापन. ब. पहिला फॅक्टरी कायदा. क. कामगार हितवर्धक सभा स्थापन करण्यात आली. ड. ऑल इंडिया ट्रेड युनियन काँग्रेसची स्थापना.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. पहिला फॅक्टरी कायदा 1881 मध्ये, मुंबईतील गिरणी कामगार संघटना सुमारे 1890 मध्ये, नंतर कामगार हितवर्धक सभा आणि शेवटी 1920 मध्ये ऑल इंडिया ट्रेड युनियन काँग्रेस — हा कालक्रम बरोबर आहे.

question: ताजमहालला औद्योगिक प्रदूषणापासून वाचवण्यासाठी भारताच्या सर्वोच्च न्यायालयात जनहित याचिका कोणी दाखल केली होती ?
explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास उत्तर D बरोबर आहे. पर्यावरणवादी वकील महेश चंद्र मेहता यांनी ताजमहालाला औद्योगिक प्रदूषणापासून वाचवण्यासाठी सर्वोच्च न्यायालयात जनहित याचिका दाखल केली — त्यामुळे आग्रा परिसरातील उद्योग, हरित belt आणि स्वच्छ इंधनावर न्यायालयीन आदेश मिळाले.

question: 1972 मध्ये झालेल्या जागतिक वसुंधरा परिषदेमध्ये पश्चिम घाटाची गणना जगातील कितव्या क्रमांकाचा अतिसंवेदनशील प्रदेश म्हणून घोषित करण्यात आला आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय C. 1972 मधील जागतिक वसुंधरा परिषदेत पश्चिम घाटांना जगातील 18व्या क्रमांकाचा अतिसंवेदनशील पर्यावरणीय प्रदेश म्हणून घोषित केले — त्यांचे जागतिक संवर्धन महत्त्व दर्शवते.

question: फैजपूर काँग्रेस अधिवेशनाच्या स्वागत समितीचे सरचिटणीस कोण होते ?
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. धनाजी नाना चौधरी यांनी 1936 मधील फैजपूर काँग्रेस अधिवेशनाच्या स्वागत समितीचे सरचिटणीसपद भूषविले — ग्रामीण महाराष्ट्रातील ते ऐतिहासिक अधिवेशन.

question: खालीलपैकी कोणत्या राज्याने भारतातील संयुक्त वन व्यवस्थापनाचा पहिला ठराव मंजूर केला ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. ओडिशा राज्याने भारतातील संयुक्त वन व्यवस्थापनाचा (JFM) पहिला अधिकृत ठराव मंजूर केला — स्थानिक समुदाय आणि वन विभाग एकत्र येऊन वनसंपत्ती संरक्षण व वापराचे नियोजन करतात.

question: भारतीय वन सर्वेक्षणानुसार, २०१३ ते २०२३ या कालावधीत महाराष्ट्रातील खालीलपैकी कोणत्या जिल्ह्यात खारफुटीच्या वनक्षेत्रात सर्वाधिक वाढ झाली आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय B. भारतीय वन सर्वेक्षणाच्या 2013–2023 कालावधीतील आकडेवारीनुसार महाराष्ट्रातील दिलेल्या किनारी जिल्ह्यांमध्ये रायगड जिल्ह्यात खारफुटीच्या वनक्षेत्रात सर्वाधिक वाढ झाली.

question: महाराष्ट्रात कोणत्या प्रकारचे हवामान आढळते ?
explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास उत्तर D बरोबर आहे. महाराष्ट्र उष्णकटिबंधीय प्रदेशात असून अनेक भागात मусळधार पाऊस, तसेच कोरडे कालावधीही आढळतात — म्हणून उष्णकटिबंधीय, आर्द्र आणि कोरडे हे सर्व लागू होतात.

question: खालील महाराष्ट्रातील नदी खोऱ्यांना उत्तरेकडून तर दक्षिणेकडे अशा क्रमाने मांडा. अ. कृष्णा नदी खोरे ब. भिमा नदी खोरे क. तापी नदी खोरे ड. प्रवरा नदी खोरे
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय D. महाराष्ट्रात उत्तरेकडून दक्षिणेकडे क्रम: तापी खोरे (क), प्रवरा (ड), भिमा (ब), कृष्णा (अ) — तापी सर्वात उत्तरेस, कृष्णा सर्वात दक्षिणेस.

question: खालील जोड्या जुळवा. वनस्पती अ. हिरडा ब. खैर क. रोशा गवत ड. तेंदु पाने उत्पादने i. सुगंधी तेल ii. टॅनिन iii. बिडी iv. कात

question: क्योटो प्रोटोकॉल अंतर्गत विकसित देशामध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणत्या घटकांमध्ये तो कमी करण्यासाठी देशांतर्गत मोठे बदल करण्याची गरज आहे ?

question: 2011 च्या जनगणनेनुसार, महाराष्ट्रातील ________ प्रशासकीय विभागात सर्वात कमी बाल्य लिंग गुणोत्तर होते.

question: २२० V (व्होल्ट) घरगुती विद्युत पुरवठ्यावर चालणाऱ्या व ०.२५ A (अँम्पिअर) विद्युत धारा वाहून नेणाऱ्या बल्बची विद्युत शक्ती (पॉवर वॅटेज) किती असेल ?
explanation: गणना केल्यास उत्तर C बरोबर आहे. P = V × I: 220 × 0.25 = 55 W. घरगुती विद्युत प्रश्नांसाठी हे सूत्र लक्षात ठेवा.

question: कोणता किरणोत्सर्गी घटक अणुउर्जा प्रकल्पामध्ये इंधन म्हणून वापरतात ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय B. अणुउर्जा प्रकल्पात नियंत्रित nuclear fission साठी युरेनियम-235 (कधीकधी प्लुटोनियम) इंधन म्हणून वापरले जाते. रेडीयम व पोलोनियम radioactive असले तरी प्रकल्प इंधन नाहीत.

question: महाराष्ट्रात खालीलपैकी कोणते खनिज मोठ्या प्रमाणात आढळते ?
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय C. लोहखनिज महाराष्ट्रात सर्वाधिक प्रमाणात आढळते — गडचिरोली, चंद्रपूर व पूर्व plateau belt मध्ये मोठे साठे आहेत, जे राज्यभरातील इस्पात कारखान्यांना पुरवतात.

subject: Science
question: बरोबर विधान निवडा. i. आवाज निर्वात पोकळीतून प्रवास करतो. ii. ऐकू येणाऱ्या आवाजाची वारंवारता 20 Hz ते 20000 Hz असते. iii. गतिमान असणाऱ्या आवाजाच्या स्रोताची वारंवारता वेगळी असते. iv. गतिमान असणाऱ्या आवाजाच्या स्रोताच्या वारंवारतेत बदल म्हणजे डॉप्लर परिणाम होय.

options.B: फक्त i, ii विधाने बरोबर आहे
options.C: फक्त ii, iii, iv विधाने बरोबर आहे
options.D: फक्त i, ii, iii विधाने बरोबर आहे

explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय C. आवाजाला माध्यम लागते — निर्वातात प्रवास करू शकत नाही (i चुकीचे). मानवी श्रवणक्षमता सुमारे 20 Hz–20,000 Hz (ii), आणि डॉप्लर परिणाम iii व iv शी जुळतो.

subject: Science
question: सेंद्रिय कचऱ्याचे रूपांतर खत व जैविक वायूमध्ये होणे, हे खालीलपैकी कोणत्या रासायनिक अभिक्रियेचे उदाहरण आहे ? अ. विस्थापन अभिक्रिया ब. समावेशन अभिक्रिया क. प्रतियोजन अभिक्रिया ड. अपघटन अभिक्रिया
explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय B. सेंद्रिय कचऱ्याचे खत व biogas मध्ये रूपांतर म्हणजे जटिल पदार्थ सरळ उत्पादनांमध्ये विघटतात — ही अपघटन अभिक्रिया आहे, विस्थापन किंवा समावेशन नाही.

subject: Science
question: बायॉलॉजिकल ऑक्सिजन डिमांड (BOD) व केमिकल ऑक्सिजन डिमांड (COD) या संज्ञा कशाची प्रदूषण पातळी मोजण्यासाठी वापरतात ? अ. हवा ब. ध्वनी क. माती ड. पाणी
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय D. BOD व COD या दोन्ही मोजमाप पाण्यातील सेंद्रिय प्रदूषक किती ऑक्सिजन वापरतात ते दर्शवतात — हे पाणी गुणवत्तेचे निकष आहेत, हवा, माती किंवा ध्वनी नाहीत.

subject: Science
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते माशाचे उदाहरण नाही ?
explanation: थेट उत्तर — पर्याय C. Ichthyophis हा caecilian — उभयचर प्राणी, मास नाही. Scoliodon (dogfish), Hippocampus (seahorse) व Labeo (रोहू) हे खरे मासे आहेत.

subject: Science
question: खाली दिलेल्या पर्यायांपैकी, कॅल्शिअम ऑक्सिक्लोराईड चे सामान्य नाव ________ असे आहे. अ. मोरचूद ब. टाकणखार क. ग्रीन व्हिट्रीओल ड. विरंजक चूर्ण

options.A: फक्त अ आणि ब चुकीचे आहेत

explanation: विश्लेषण केल्यास उत्तर B बरोबर आहे. कॅल्शिअम ऑक्सिक्लोराईड म्हणजे विरंजक चूर्ण (CaOCl₂), पाणी शुद्धीकरणासाठी. मोरचूद = तांब्याचे sulphate, टाकणखार = sodium borate, ग्रीन vitriol = ferrous sulphate.

subject: Science
question: पक्षांची निदान वैशिष्ट्ये - ______________. अ. पिसांची चादर ब. हवेचा श्वास क. उबदार रक्त ड. वरीलपैकी सर्व
explanation: योग्य उत्तर — पर्याय D. पक्षांची ओळख पिसे, फुफ्फुसांद्वारे हवा श्वास आणि उबदार रक्त — ही तिन्ही वैशिष्ट्ये एकत्र; एकटे वैशिष्ट्य पुरेसे नाही.

subject: Science
question: संबंधीत फायलम व त्यातील प्राण्याची जोडी लावा. अ. प्रोटोझुआ - i. बटरफ्लाय ब. सिलेंटेरेटा - ii. प्लाझमोडियम क. आर्थ्रोपोडा - iii. स्टारफिश ड. एकिनोडग्मयाटा - iv. हायड्रा
explanation: योग्य जोडी — पर्याय B. Plasmodium = Protozoa, Hydra = Coelenterata, Butterfly = Arthropoda, Starfish = Echinodermata — प्रत्येक प्राणी त्याच्या योग्य phylum शी जुळवा.

subject: Economy
question: पिकांवर होणाऱ्या किटकविकारांवर उपाय करण्यासाठी जास्त टिकाऊ व पर्यावरणपूरक अशी पुढील दिल्या प्रमाणे कोणते उपाय जास्त उपयोगी आहेत ? i. रासायनिक किटकनाशके ii. मायकोराईझा (मूळकवक) iii. पिक रोटेशन (फिरवणे) iv. दगडफूले वरीलपैकी कोणते विधान/विधाने बरोबर आहेत ?
explanation: अधिकृत उत्तर — पर्याय C. मायकोराईझा मुळे मजबूत करतात व पिक फिरवणे कीटक चक्र तोडते — दोन्ही पर्यावरणपूरक. रासायनिक किटकनाशके हानिकारक, दगडफूले कीटक नियंत्रणाचे साधन नाहीत.

subject: Science
question: वनस्पतींचे पहिले नैसर्गिक वर्गीकरण कुठल्या वर्षी आणि कोणी सादर केले होते ?

options.D: १८८३, जी. बेन्थम आणि जे. डी. हुकर

explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. 1789 मध्ये अँटोइन लॉरेंट डी जुसी यांनी *Genera Plantarum* मध्ये वनस्पतींचे पहिले व्यापक नैसर्गिक वर्गीकरण मांडले. नंतर कॅन्डॉल आणि बेन्थम–हुकर यांच्या प्रणाली या पायऱ्यांवर उभ्या राहिल्या.

subject: Geography
question: जी.आय.एस. मध्ये खालीलपैकी कोणते गुणविशेष आधारसामग्रीचे उदाहरण आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. जी.आय.एस. मध्ये गुणविशेष आधारसामग्री म्हणजे भूमीउपयोजनासारख्या वैशिष्ट्यांची माहिती; अक्षांश–रेखांश व स्थान–विस्तार ही अवकाशीय (spatial) माहिती असते.

subject: Science
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते वनस्पती संप्रेरक आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. सायटोकायनीन हे वनस्पती संप्रेरक असून कोश विभाजनास चालना देतात. अॅसीटीलीन वायू, फॉर्मलीन संवर्धक आणि स्ट्रेप्टोमायसीन प्रतिजैविक आहेत — हे वनस्पती संप्रेरक नाहीत.

subject: Geography
question: खालीलपैकी कोणते साधन हवाई छायाचित्र त्रिमिती सम्यक दर्शन होण्यासाठी वापरले जाते ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. स्टेरिओस्कोप overlapping हवाई छायाचित्रे जोडून प्रत्येक डोळ्याला वेगळे दृश्य देतो, त्यामुळे भूप्रदेश त्रिमितीय दिसतो. हे छायाचित्रनिर्मितीचे साधन आहे, साठवण उपकरण नाही.

subject: Geography
question: उपग्रह व विमानांद्वारे मिळविलेल्या सांख्यिकी आणि प्रतिमा प्राप्त करणे, प्रक्रिया करणे व अर्थ लावण्याच्या शास्त्रास खालीलपैकी कोणते शास्त्र म्हणतात ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. सुदूर संवेदन म्हणजे विमान व उपग्रहांकडून मिळवलेला सांख्यिकी व प्रतिमा डेटा संपर्काशिवाय गोळा करून, प्रक्रिया करून व अर्थ लावण्याचे शास्त्र. हवाई छायाचित्रण ही एक पद्धत; जी.आय.एस. व जी.पी.एस. वेगळी कामे करतात.

subject: Geography
question: इलेक्ट्रोमॅग्नेटिक स्पेक्ट्रमचा खालीलपैकी कोणता भाग रिमोट सेन्सिंगमध्ये वापरला जातो ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. उपग्रह व हवाई सेन्सर दृश्य, अवरक्त व मायक्रोव्हेव या तिन्ही भागांचा वापर करतात — प्रत्येक भाग भूपृष्ठाच्या वेगळ्या गुणधर्मांसाठी उपयुक्त. म्हणून तिन्ही रिमोट सेन्सिंगमध्ये येतात.

subject: Science
question: मॉनिटर किंवा व्हिडिओ डिस्प्ले युनिटचा आकार स्क्रीनच्या _________ लांबीमध्ये मोजला जातो.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय C आहे. मॉनिटर किंवा टीव्हीचा आकार स्क्रीनच्या कर्णरेषेच्या (diagonal) लांबीने मोजतात — हेच बाजारात दिसणारे मानक आहे.

subject: Science
question: OSI मॉडेलमध्ये डेटा लिंक लेयरची खालीलपैकी कोणती प्राथमिक जबाबदारी आहे ?

options.A: अनेक नेटवर्क्समधून पॅकेट्सना त्यांच्या गंतव्यस्थानावर मार्गनिश्चिती (राऊट) करणे
options.B: प्रेषणासाठी (ट्रान्समिशनसाठी) नेटवर्क लेयर पॅकेट्सना फ्रेम्समध्ये बंदिस्त करणे
options.C: पूर्णत: संवाद प्रस्थापित करणे आणि विश्वसनीय वितरण सुनिश्चित करणे
options.D: भौतिक प्रसारणासाठी डेटाचे इलेक्ट्रिकल सिग्नलमध्ये रूपांतर करणे

explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. डेटा लिंक लेयर (लेयर 2) नेटवर्क लेयरचे पॅकेट्स फ्रेम्समध्ये बंदिस्त करून प्रसारणासाठी तयार करते. राऊटिंग नेटवर्क लेयरचे; विश्वसनीय वितरण ट्रान्सपोर्ट लेयरचे; सिग्नल रूपांतर फिजिकल लेयरचे.

subject: Science
question: यु.आर.एल. (U.R.L.) म्हणजे _________ .
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. U.R.L. म्हणजे Uniform Resource Locator — इंटरनेटवरील पृष्ठ किंवा फाइल कुठे आहे हे सांगणारा पत्ता.

subject: Polity
question: _________ रोजी 'माहिती तंत्रज्ञान कायदा, 2000' च्या तरतुदी लागू झाल्या.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय D आहे. माहिती तंत्रज्ञान कायदा, 2000 जूनमध्ये मंजूर झाला, पण बहुतेक तरतुदी 17 ऑक्टोबर 2000 रोजी अधिसूचित करून लागू झाल्या.

subject: Current Affairs
question: वर्ल्ड हॅपीनेस अहवाल २०१८ मधील सर्वात दु:खी देश कोणता ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. वर्ल्ड हॅपीनेस अहवाल 2018 मध्ये बुरुंडी सर्वात खाली — सर्वात दु:खी देश — होता; फिनलंड सर्वोच्च स्थानी होते.

subject: Economy
question: राष्ट्रीय लोकसंख्या धोरण, २००० नुसार कोणत्या वर्षापर्यंत लोकसंख्या स्थिर करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट आहे ?
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय B आहे. राष्ट्रीय लोकसंख्या धोरण, 2000 नुसार आरोग्य, शिक्षण व कुटुंब नियोजनाद्वारे 2045 पर्यंत लोकसंख्या स्थिर करण्याचे उद्दिष्ट होते.

subject: Economy
question: योग्य पर्यायांची जोडी ओळखा. सूची-I i. आर्थिक नियोजन ii. १२ वी पंचवार्षिक योजना iii. नीति आयोग iv. नीति आयोगाचे उपाध्यक्ष सूची-II अ. पंतप्रधानांकडून निवड ब. भारत सरकारचे धोरण राबविणारा विचार गट क. जलद व शाश्वत वृद्धी ड. कालबद्ध कार्यक्रम

options.A: i – क, ii – अ, iii – ड, iv – ब
options.B: i – ड, ii – ब, iii – अ, iv – क
options.C: i – ड, ii – क, iii – ब, iv – अ
options.D: i – ब, ii – ड, iii – क, iv – अ

explanation: योग्य जोडी (पर्याय C): i. आर्थिक नियोजन → ड. कालबद्ध कार्यक्रम ii. १२ वी पंचवार्षिक योजना → क. जलद व शाश्वत वृद्धी iii. नीति आयोग → ब. भारत सरकारचे धोरण राबविणारा विचार गट (थिंक टँक) iv. नीति आयोगाचे उपाध्यक्ष → अ. पंतप्रधानांकडून निवड अधिकृत उत्तर키नुसार पर्याय C.

subject: Economy
question: निरपेक्ष दारिद्र्याचे मापन _______ या द्वारे केले जाते.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. भारतीय संदर्भात निरपेक्ष दारिद्र्याचे मापन किमान उष्मांक (calorie) सेवनाने होते — फक्त उत्पन्न किंवा संपत्तीने नाही.

subject: Economy
question: फिलिप्स वक्र _______ यांच्यातील संबंध दर्शवितो.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. फिलिप्स वक्र अल्पकालीन महागाई व बेरोजगारी यांच्यातील व्यस्त संबंध दाखवतो — एक कमी झाल्यास दुसरे वाढते.

subject: Economy
question: डिसेंबर १९७१ पर्यंत आंतरराष्ट्रीय नाणे निधीचे चलन ______ हे होते.
explanation: योग्य उत्तर पर्याय A आहे. ब्रेटन वूड्स व्यवस्थेत डिसेंबर 1971 पर्यंत आंतरराष्ट्रीय नाणे निधीचे मुख्य चलन यु.एस. डॉलर होते.

subject: Economy
question: कोणते विधान बरोबर आहे ? अ. अवमूल्यन म्हणजे चलनाचा विनिमय मूल्य किंवा इतर देशाच्या चलनाच्या तुलनेत त्याची खरेदीशक्ती कमी करणे. ब. अवमूल्यनाचा मोठा फायदा म्हणजे आयात वाढणे.

question: Which of the following Social Work Organizations were established through Prarthana Samaj? (a) Social Service League - N.M. Joshi (b) Servants of India Society - G.K. Gokhale (c) Arya Samaj - Dayanand Saraswati (d) Depressed Classes Mission - V.R. Shinde
explanation: Prarthana Samaj (1867, Mumbai) seeded several reform bodies: G.K. Gokhale's Servants of India Society (1905), N.M. Joshi's Social Service League, and V.R. Shinde's Depressed Classes Mission all trace to that milieu. Arya Samaj was Dayanand Saraswati's separate north-Indian revival movement—not a Prarthana Samaj offshoot. Options mixing in (c) trap students who lump every 19th-century samaj under one banner.

question: Which Act was described by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru as 'a new charter of Slavery'?
explanation: The answer is option C: Jawaharlal Nehru attacked the Government of India Act, 1935 as a 'new charter of slavery' because it entrenched colonial control—provincial autonomy on paper, but veto power, princely-state safeguards, and no real self-rule. Morley–Minto (1909) and Montagu–Chelmsford (1919) drew other epithets; Rowlatt (1919) was the 'black' repressive law—not Nehru's 1935 phrase. You can eliminate A (The Morley-Minto Reforms Act, 1909), B (The Montagu-Chelmsford Reforms Act, 1919), D (Rowlatt Act, 1919) — each one conflicts with the principle or calculation that leads to option C.
